    segments = case['segments']
    budget = case['budget']
    N = len(segments)
    min_sum = sum(s['minimum'] for s in segments)
    cap_sum = sum(s['capacity'] for s in segments)
    if not (min_sum <= budget <= cap_sum):
        raise ValueError("Budget out of feasible range")
    allocations = [s['minimum'] for s in segments]
    remaining = budget - min_sum
    from fractions import Fraction  # inside function to avoid global import? fine.

        best_key = None

        remaining -= 1
    total = budget

        "allocations": allocations,
        "by_name": by_name,
        "total": total
    }
